question: Which attributes of Savitṛ, the lord, are emphasized in this description?
premises: Savitṛ is described as having the world as his form
Savitṛ is described as creator and shining
inference: Savitṛ is characterized as the world-formed, creating, shining lord.
plain_english: Of Savitṛ, whose form is the world, the creator, the shining lord.
